minigames.name: Red Light
minigames.goal: Be the first to reach the finish line.
howTo: Hold the button to run while the light is green.
Let go as soon as it turns red. Yellow can be a fake-out!
Caught moving on red? Back to the start.
minigames.rules: Hold to run. Move while the light is red and you're back at the start. First to the finish wins.
minigames.controls: Hold the button to move, let go to stop.

minigames.name: Musical Chairs
minigames.goal: Be the last player still sitting.
howTo: Wait while the music plays.
When it stops, chairs appear: tap one fast.
No chair = you're out. One chair fewer each round.
minigames.rules: When the music stops, tap a chair fast. One chair fewer than players. Last one sitting wins.
minigames.controls: Tap a chair when the music stops.

minigames.name: Chicken
minigames.goal: Cash out the biggest pot without crashing.
howTo: Press and hold the button before the pot starts.
The pot grows while you hold. Let go to cash out that amount.
It crashes at a secret moment: still holding = 0.
minigames.rules: Everyone holds while the pot grows. Let go to cash out. If it crashes while you hold, you get nothing.
minigames.controls: Hold the button. Release to cash out.
minigames.bonus: See the range where it crashes.

minigames.name: Reaction Tap
minigames.goal: Have the fastest reaction time.
howTo: Tap to start a round and wait on the red screen.
Tap the moment it turns green.
Best of 3 counts. Tapping too early costs time.
minigames.rules: Tap the moment the screen turns green. Best of 3. False starts cost you.

minigames.name: Stacker
minigames.goal: Build the tallest tower.
howTo: A block slides back and forth above your tower.
Tap to drop it. Whatever hangs over the edge is cut off.
Miss the tower completely and your game ends.
minigames.rules: A block slides back and forth. Tap to drop it. Overhang gets cut. Tallest tower wins.

minigames.name: Pump It
minigames.goal: Bank the most pumps over 3 balloons.
howTo: Tap Pump to inflate the balloon. Each pump is a point.
Tap Stop to bank the points before it pops.
A popped balloon scores 0. Same pop points for everyone.
minigames.rules: Pump the balloon. Stop before it pops. Biggest unpopped balloon wins.
minigames.controls: Tap to pump, press Stop to bank it.
minigames.bonus: A hint of where it pops.

minigames.name: Memory Flip
minigames.goal: Find all pairs the fastest.
howTo: Tap two cards to flip them.
Matching pairs stay open, others flip back.
Fastest to clear the board wins.
minigames.rules: Find all the pairs. Fastest wins.

minigames.name: Stop the Bar
minigames.goal: Score the most accuracy points in 3 rounds.
howTo: A marker swings across the bar.
Tap to stop it inside the green zone.
Dead center = 100 points, outside = 0.
minigames.rules: A bar swings back and forth. Stop it inside the zone. 3 rounds, accuracy counts.

minigames.name: Higher or Lower
minigames.goal: Build the longest streak.
howTo: Look at the card.
Guess if the next card is higher or lower (same value counts as correct).
One wrong guess ends your streak.
minigames.rules: Is the next card higher or lower? Longest streak wins.

minigames.name: Spot the Odd One
minigames.goal: Reach the highest level.
howTo: One icon in the grid is different.
Tap it to go to the next, bigger grid.
Wrong taps send you back a level.
minigames.rules: Find the icon that's different. The grid keeps growing.

minigames.name: Count It
minigames.goal: Be the closest when counting, over 3 rounds.
howTo: Check which icon you have to count.
Tap when ready: icons flash for a moment.
Enter how many you saw. Being off adds up.
minigames.rules: Icons flash for a moment. How many of one kind were there? Closest wins.

minigames.name: Color Clash
minigames.goal: Get the most right answers in 20 seconds.
howTo: A color word appears in a different ink color.
Tap the button of the INK color, not the word.
Right +1, wrong −1.
minigames.rules: Tap the ink color, not the word. Most correct in 20 seconds.

minigames.name: Whack-a-Mole
minigames.goal: Score the most points.
howTo: Moles pop up out of the holes: whack them for +1.
Avoid bombs: −3.
They disappear quickly, so be fast.
minigames.rules: Whack the moles as they pop up. Avoid the bombs!

minigames.name: Perfect Timing
minigames.goal: Stop closest to exactly 10.00 seconds.
howTo: Tap Start.
The timer hides after a moment: count in your head.
Tap Stop when you think 10 seconds have passed.
minigames.rules: Stop a hidden timer at exactly 10.00 seconds.
minigames.bonus: The timer is visible for the first 3 seconds.

minigames.name: Type Race
minigames.goal: Type the phrase fastest and correctly.
howTo: Type the phrase shown on screen.
It finishes automatically when it's exact (or tap Done).
Each mistake adds 1.5 seconds.
minigames.rules: Type the phrase as fast and accurately as you can.

minigames.name: Quick Math
minigames.goal: Solve the most sums in 20 seconds.
howTo: A sum appears with four answers.
Tap the right one to get the next sum.
Only correct answers count.
minigames.rules: Solve as many sums as you can in 20 seconds.

minigames.name: Simon
minigames.goal: Repeat the longest sequence.
howTo: Watch the pads light up.
Tap them in the same order.
Each round adds one more. One mistake ends it.
minigames.rules: Repeat the growing color sequence. One mistake and you're out.

minigames.name: Minefield
minigames.goal: Be the last one standing.
howTo: Take turns picking a tile on the grid.
One tile hides a bomb: pick it and you're out.
A new grid starts after each explosion.
minigames.rules: Take turns picking tiles. One hides a bomb. Last one standing wins.
minigames.controls: Tap a tile on your turn.
minigames.bonus: One safe tile is revealed to you.

minigames.name: Thin Ice
minigames.goal: Be the last one who can still move.
howTo: On your turn, move to a glowing tile next to you.
The tile you leave breaks into a hole.
No safe tile to move to? You fall in.
minigames.rules: Tiles crack after you step off them. Move in turns. Can't move? You're out.
minigames.controls: Tap a neighboring tile on your turn.
minigames.bonus: Start next to more safe tiles.

minigames.name: Hot Potato
minigames.goal: Don't be holding the bomb when it explodes.
howTo: If you have the bomb, beat the quick challenge to pass it on (match, colour, odd one out, count).
A wrong tap gives you a new challenge and a short delay.
The fuse is secret. Last survivor wins.
minigames.rules: Beat a quick reflex challenge to pass the bomb. The hidden fuse explodes on someone.
minigames.bonus: One revive: survive your first explosion.

minigames.name: Split or Steal
minigames.goal: Walk away with the most coins.
howTo: There's a pot of 10 coins.
Secretly choose Split or Steal.
Both split: 5 each. One steals: they take all. Both steal: nobody gets anything.
minigames.rules: A pot of coins. Secretly choose to split or steal. Both steal? Nobody gets anything.
minigames.bonus: Learn if the other player took more than 3s to decide.

minigames.name: Mystery Auction
minigames.goal: Make the most profit from the boxes.
howTo: Each box hides coins (some hide losses!).
Bid on the boxes you want. Your total bids can't exceed your coins.
Highest bid pays and gets what's inside.
minigames.rules: Bid coins on 3 mystery boxes. Highest bidder pays and gets the contents.
minigames.controls: Enter a bid for each box.

minigames.name: Hot or Not
minigames.goal: Guess right more often than the others.
howTo: The target secretly answers a number about themselves.
A different number is shown.
Guess whether the real answer is higher or lower.
minigames.rules: The target answers a number secretly. A number is shown: is their real answer higher or lower?

minigames.name: Duel
minigames.goal: Be closer to the truth than your opponent.
howTo: A number question about a player appears.
Answer as close as you can (the target answers honestly).
Closest steals 5 coins from the other.
minigames.rules: Answer a number question. Closest steals 5 coins from the other.

minigames.name: Most Likely To
minigames.goal: Vote with the majority.
howTo: Read the 'Who's most likely to…' prompt.
Vote for a player (yourself included).
Everyone who picked the most-voted player scores.
minigames.rules: Who's most likely to…? Vote for a player. Being in the majority scores.

minigames.name: Speed Sync
minigames.goal: Match the target fast, 5 times.
howTo: A quick question about one player appears.
Pick what they'll answer (the target answers honestly).
Match = 2 points, +1 for answering in the first half.
minigames.rules: 5 quick questions, 8 seconds each. Match the target fast for more points.

minigames.name: Ranking
minigames.goal: Rank things exactly like the target.
howTo: Order 4 items the way the target would.
Drag them or use the arrows, then lock in.
1 point per item in the right spot.
minigames.rules: Rank 4 things the way the target would. Points per correct position.
minigames.controls: Drag to reorder, then lock in.
